app.name: Photo Coach
app.description: Upload a photo and the AI shows what works and how to shoot better: composition, ratio, light, aperture.

localMode.hint: Fill in .env.local following docs/PHASE0-SETUP.md to use real services.

fact.shake_risk: Shutter {shutter} is slower than the safe handheld speed ({safeShutter}) → shake/blur risk.
fact.wide_aperture: Wide aperture f/{f} → background blur, thin focus plane.
fact.diffraction: Small aperture f/{f} → may soften due to diffraction.
fact.highlights_clipped: {percent}% of pixels are blown out, mostly {region}.
fact.shadows_clipped: {percent}% of pixels are crushed to black, mostly {region}.
fact.high_dynamic_range: Scene exceeds the sensor's range (blown {highlights}%, crushed {shadows}%) → use HDR.
fact.well_exposed: Well balanced exposure (mean {mean}/255, almost no clipping).
fact.low_contrast: Low contrast, the image looks a bit flat.
fact.soft_focus: Low measured sharpness → possible missed focus or shake.
fact.sharp: The sharpest area is very crisp.

privacy.title: Privacy
items: Your photos are stored privately. Only you can view them, through short-lived links.
GPS location is NOT saved by default. You can choose to keep it when uploading.
To analyze, a downscaled copy (max 1536px) is sent to Google Gemini. On the free tier, Google may use this data to improve its products.
You can delete a photo at any time from History. Deleting removes the file and all analyses permanently.
We only use your Google account's email, name and avatar to sign you in.

editor.title: Edit photo
editor.loadFailed: Couldn't load the original photo. Check your connection and try again.
editor.downscaled: the original is very large, so it was scaled down for the browser
editor.aiHint: Straightens the horizon, crops to the suggested frame and adjusts light & colour from the analysis. You can still fine-tune every slider.
editor.aiNothing: According to the analysis, this photo needs no further edits.

remove.hint: Paint over what you want to remove (passers-by, litter, wires…). Lift your finger and the AI erases it.
remove.modelFirst: The first time, the AI model needs to download (~{mb} MB, free). Your browser keeps it for next time.
remove.modelReady: AI model ready — it runs on your device, your photo isn't sent anywhere.
remove.tip: Tip: cover the object's shadow too. Very large objects may look smudged — erasing in small parts works better.

crop.dragHint: Drag the frame on the photo to position the crop.
